{{Quote|You've led this corporation well, Kuat. And through times perhaps more difficult than any faced by your predecessors; you've proven yourself to be the true heir of the Kuat Drive Yards' helm.|The supervisor, to the Kuat of Kuat|<ref name="Hard Merchandise" />}}
A grizzled, [[Color/Legends|white]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as a [[Β-supervisor|β-supervisor]] at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], leader of the shipbuilding team that laid down the central frames of the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] at the KDY docks, during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He served as a lead operator of the dockyards' cranes during the tenure of [[Kuat's father|one]] of the [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuats of Kuat]], and β-supervisor during the tenure of that person's [[Kuat (person)|son]].<ref name="Hard Merchandise" />

This β-supervisor believed that that Kuat of Kuat had led the corporation well and had proven himself as the true heir to Kuat Drive Yards, and for this reason agreed to pledge his loyalty to the Kuat of Kuat personally.<ref name="Hard Merchandise" />
